hooks.name: Risk engine tests on save
hooks.description: When a file in the risk engine folder is saved, run the unit and property-based tests for the risk engine.

action.prompt: A file in lib/risk-engine/ was just saved. Run the risk engine unit and property-based tests with `npx vitest run lib/risk-engine`. If any test fails, report the failing test names and the counterexample (for property tests), then stop. Do not change code unless asked.
